name: com.tapsdk.tapad.stub.activity.Stub_Interstitial_Portrait_Activity
description: TapTap's TapAD advertising SDK opens this screen when a portrait interstitial ad is shown; it plays the ad and handles its click and advertised-app download controls.
disableEffect: Portrait interstitial ads and their click or download actions will no longer work, while the host app's other features remain available.
